text: Starling — the vllm-server frontend. Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime via vLLM's WebSocket realtime API.
New session: pick a media file, a transcription mode, click Create.
broadcast_1_90s.wav — 90 seconds of Salzburg news, German, mixed speakers, real names.
Audio streams via WebRTC → FFmpeg → vLLM. First caption arrives in well under a second.
All eager-mode on the GPU. Background WebSocket reader so we never drop a delta.
Sentence splitter handles ’19. November’ and ‘Dr.’ without breaking the line.
Context rotates every ~100 s so the KV cache never runs out. Long-form transcription, no babysitting.
